$comment: THE canonical promotional banner canvas (029). One definition; three consumers — the back-office
tool, the generated template SVG, and the Compose theme.
⚠ WHY JSON. `scripts/gen-compose-theme.mjs` is plain Node ESM and cannot import a TypeScript
module; the console needs these as numbers and cannot read a CSS custom property. JSON is the one
format both ends consume without build-tool coupling (research R4).
⚠ WHY NOT tokens.css. That file is the BRAND source of truth — colours, spacing, radii, typeface.
A 1200px image canvas is an asset constraint, not a style token, and putting it there would be a
category error that the next person copies.
⚠ NOTHING may hardcode these numbers. If a value appears in a component, a script or a test
without coming from here, the drift this file exists to prevent has already happened.
Where the platform draws the promotion's LIVE message over the artwork (FR-031b).
⚠ This is NOT a 'trim-safe' region. Because conformant artwork and the render box share one
aspect ratio, the scale is uniform and nothing is ever cropped — a trim-safe zone would be the
whole canvas and would tell an operator nothing (research R2).
What an operator actually needs to know is which part of their picture the platform is going to
print text on, so they can leave it quiet. That is this.
